message.content: {"note_claim": "Pro-Saudi Yemeni government forces (local Yemeni allied fighters, not Saudi troops) retreated in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces including Mokha and Hays as the Houthis advanced.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Yemen's Houthis seized control of the strategic Red Sea port city of Mocha on Thursday", "reason": "The page confirms Houthi capture of Mocha and advances in Khokha and Hays against Yemeni government forces (Tarek Saleh's National Resistance Forces moved their command to regroup), consistent with the note, but it reports no surrenders and does not explicitly state the fighters are Yemeni rather than Saudi troops."}

parsed.note_claim: Pro-Saudi Yemeni government forces (local Yemeni allied fighters, not Saudi troops) retreated in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces including Mokha and Hays as the Houthis advanced.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Yemen's Houthis seized control of the strategic Red Sea port city of Mocha on Thursday
parsed.reason: The page confirms Houthi capture of Mocha and advances in Khokha and Hays against Yemeni government forces (Tarek Saleh's National Resistance Forces moved their command to regroup), consistent with the note, but it reports no surrenders and does not explicitly state the fighters are Yemeni rather than Saudi troops.
